execute_js.body: async () => { const api = await import('/src/api.ts'); const c = await api.createConversation('Recents verification chat'); const ids = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('recents-test-created-ids')); ids.push(c.id); sessionStorage.setItem('recents-test-created-ids',JSON.stringify(ids)); const saved = (await api.getConversations()).find(x=>x.id===c.id); if(saved?.workspace_mode !== 'chat') throw new Error('Wrong saved mode'); return {id:c.id,mode:saved.workspace_mode}; }

wait_for_function.expression: () => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-recents-mode="chat"]'); return !!el && el.innerText.includes('Recents verification chat') && !el.innerText.includes('Recents verification cowork') && !el.innerText.includes('Recents verification code'); }
